attributes.name: exclusive

elements.description: One collapsible section on a native details element, with an animated panel where the browser supports it.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Header text.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Expanded.

events.name: pk-toggle
events.description: The section opened or closed.

elements.name: pk-alert
elements.description: A persistent message in a kind (info, success, warning, danger): optional heading, actions, a dismiss button, a full-bleed banner variant for the top of a page, and a plain form (coloured text only, optionally inline and compact).

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: The kind setting

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The heading setting

attributes.name: dismissible
attributes.description: The dismissible setting

attributes.name: banner

attributes.name: inline

attributes.name: compact
attributes.description: Smaller text and no margin, for an actions strip.

events.name: pk-dismiss
events.description: Dismissed; cancelable.

elements.name: pk-app-shell
elements.description: The page frame: nav column, header, one scrolling body and footer. Header and footer stay put; safe-area insets are added on notched phones; a slotted control marked data-nav-toggle opens the side nav drawer.

attributes.name: nav-open

attributes.name: flush

events.name: pk-nav-toggle
events.description: A data-nav-toggle control was pressed.

elements.name: pk-avatar
elements.description: A person or entity as an image or initials, with sizes, shapes, a stable colour per name and an online, away or busy status dot.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The accessible name and the source of the initials.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: An image URL; initials show until it loads or if it fails.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: Shape.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status dot.

attributes.name: colour
attributes.description: A colour slot 1 to 5, or muted; by default a stable slot chosen from the name.

elements.name: pk-avatar-group
elements.description: Overlapping avatars with a +N tile for the overflow.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Avatars shown before the +N tile.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the group.

elements.name: pk-back-to-top
elements.description: A floating button that appears once the reader is well down the page and scrolls the page (or a named scroller) back to the top, smoothly unless reduced motion is on.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Scroll container (default: the window).

attributes.name: threshold
attributes.description: The threshold setting

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: Set by the element.

elements.name: pk-badge
elements.description: A count or short label in a pill, or a status dot with a label; counts cap at a maximum (99+).

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Colour.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Value to show when the slot is empty, capped by max.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Counts above read as max+; 0 disables capping.

attributes.name: dot
attributes.description: A status dot with the text as its label instead of a pill.

elements.name: pk-breadcrumb
elements.description: The path to the current page as a trail of links with chevrons; the middle collapses behind a "..." button when the trail is long, sooner on a phone.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Landmark name.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Crumbs shown before the middle folds (3 on a phone).

slots.name: default
slots.description: a elements; the last one is the current page.

events.name: pk-expand
events.description: The fold button revealed the hidden crumbs.

elements.name: pk-button
elements.description: A button in five variants and three sizes, with busy, icon-only and toggle forms. type="submit" and "reset" act on the surrounding form, as a native button does.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Visual weight.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: md is the reading-size control; mini is the compact desktop-density one; lg is the large one.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: What a click does inside a form: nothing, submit it, or reset it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control. Also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: An accessible name when the visible content is only an icon.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Shows a spinner and ignores clicks without disabling the button, so focus stays put.

attributes.name: busy-text
attributes.description: Replaces the label while busy.

attributes.name: block
attributes.description: Fills the width of its container.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: A square icon-only button (give it a label).

attributes.name: toggle
attributes.description: A button that stays pressed: a click flips pressed.

attributes.name: pressed
attributes.description: The pressed state of a toggle button.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: A value reported by pk-toggle.

events.name: click
events.description: A click (not fired while disabled or busy).

events.name: pk-toggle
events.description: A toggle button was pressed or released.

elements.name: pk-button-group
elements.description: Buttons fused into one bar, horizontal, vertical or full width; with mode="single" its toggle buttons behave as one choice, which makes it the SDK's segmented control (a Dark/Light switch, a view or density picker).

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Direction of the bar.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Fills the container width and shares it between the buttons.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the group (aria-label).

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: single: the toggle buttons in the group release each other (one is always pressed); multi and none leave each toggle alone.

elements.name: pk-calendar
elements.description: A small month grid to pick or show a date, with marks, minimum and maximum, and full keyboard control.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected day, an ISO date such as 2026-09-19.

attributes.name: month
attributes.description: An ISO date whose month is shown; defaults to the value or today.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Earliest selectable ISO date.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Latest selectable ISO date.

attributes.name: week-start
attributes.description: First weekday: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Language of month and weekday names; defaults to the page language.

attributes.name: marks
attributes.description: ISO dates that get a dot.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Show only; no selection.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Inert.

events.name: pk-select
events.description: A day was chosen. Cancel to keep the current value.

events.name: pk-month
events.description: The shown month changed (yyyy-mm).

elements.name: pk-card
elements.description: A titled panel with optional media, header actions and footer. Vertical or horizontal (stacking by its own width), flush for tables, and optionally one link.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The card title. Without it (and without actions) the header is not shown.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The heading level the title exposes to assistive technology (aria-level).

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: error draws the border in the error colour.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Horizontal puts the media beside the content; it stacks when the card is narrower than 30rem (a container query, not the viewport).

attributes.name: flush
attributes.description: No padding around the body, for a table or an edge-to-edge body; the heading row keeps its padding.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the whole card one link (a single tab stop named by the heading).

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Fills a flex parent (a workspace pane): the card takes the remaining height, has no padding, and its body is the scroll region.

slots.name: media
slots.description: An image, picture or video at the top (or the start when horizontal).

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons or links at the right of the header.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Content below the body; hidden when empty.

elements.name: pk-chart
elements.description: Bar, line, donut, stacked-bar and sparkline charts in pure SVG, drawn from a slotted data table (which stays as the accessible fallback) or from a data property.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Chart type.

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: Title (figcaption).

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: viewBox height of bar and line charts.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Data as a property instead of a table: { labels: string[], series: { name, values: number[] }[] }.

attributes.name: data-label
attributes.description: Summary text of the data details.

slots.name: default
slots.description: A table: the first column holds labels, each further column a series. A cell may carry data-value.

elements.name: pk-checkbox
elements.description: A checkbox drawn from tokens, with an indeterminate state and select-all groups: a master checkbox mirrors every checkbox of its group.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value submitted while checked.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether the box is checked. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising the commit event, as a native control does: pk-form raises pk-reset after it, so a host that mirrors the value reads it again there. A browser state restore also sets it silently.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: The mixed state (some of a group are checked).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: Puts this checkbox in a select-all group of that name.

attributes.name: master
attributes.description: Makes this the select-all checkbox of the group of that name; it shows checked, unchecked or indeterminate as its members change.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: sm is the compact checkbox of a toolbar: smaller label text.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-change
events.description: The user changed the value (same moment as change; carries it).

elements.name: pk-cluster
elements.description: A wrapping row (or column) of controls with a fixed gap: the layout primitive for button rows, chip lists and toolbars.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Row (wraps at the edge) or column.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Space between children, on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8). Default sm (the control gap).

attributes.name: align
attributes.description: Cross-axis alignment of the items.

attributes.name: justify
attributes.description: Main-axis distribution of the items.

attributes.name: nowrap
attributes.description: Keep a horizontal cluster on one line instead of wrapping (wrapping is the default).

elements.name: pk-code-block
elements.description: A block of code with an optional label bar, line numbers, a wrap toggle and a copy button. The code is the element's text content.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: File or language shown in the bar; also the region's name.

attributes.name: line-numbers
attributes.description: A gutter of line numbers.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: Wrap long lines.

attributes.name: no-copy
attributes.description: Hide the copy button.

attributes.name: max-height
attributes.description: Cap the height, any CSS length.

events.name: pk-copy
events.description: After a copy attempt.

events.name: pk-wrap-change
events.description: The wrap toggle was pressed; wrap already has the new value.

elements.name: pk-colour-input
elements.description: The native colour picker beside an editable hex field that stay in step; the field accepts #abc, abc and #aabbcc and is normalised to #rrggbb.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The colour as #rrggbb. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising the commit event, as a native control does: pk-form raises pk-reset after it, so a host that mirrors the value reads it again there. A browser state restore also sets it silently.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: show-label
attributes.description: Shows label as visible text above the field (linked to it), for use without a pk-field.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-colour
events.description: A valid colour was picked or typed (lowercase #rrggbb).

elements.name: pk-combobox
elements.description: An autocomplete (type to filter a list) or, with mode="select", a custom select. ARIA combobox with the highlight tracked by aria-activedescendant, so focus stays on the control. Its options are its own option children.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: autocomplete filters as you type; select is a button that opens the list (type a letter to jump). Prefer the native pk-select on a phone.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The current value; what the form submits. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising the commit event, as a native control does: pk-form raises pk-reset after it, so a host that mirrors the value reads it again there. A browser state restore also sets it silently.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint shown while empty.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

attributes.name: free
attributes.description: Autocomplete: keep typed text that is not an option, and use it as the value.

attributes.name: filtering
attributes.description: client also filters the options here; off leaves filtering to the host, which listens for pk-combo-query and replaces the options.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the list is open.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: The message shown when nothing matches.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-combo-select
events.description: An option was chosen.

events.name: pk-combo-query
events.description: The user typed: the text so far, so a host can fetch more options (with filtering="off" it also replaces the client filter).

events.name: pk-combo-toggle
events.description: The list opened or closed by itself (typing, a click, a key, focus leaving); open already has the new value. Not raised for a change the host made.

elements.name: pk-command-palette
elements.description: A keyboard-first launcher: Ctrl/Cmd+K opens a dialog with a search field over grouped commands, fuzzy-matched with highlights, recents when the field is empty, arrows and Enter to run.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether it is shown

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: The placeholder setting

attributes.name: recents-key
attributes.description: localStorage key; empty disables recents.

attributes.name: no-shortcut
attributes.description: Do not bind Ctrl/Cmd+K on the document.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the dialog.

events.name: pk-select

events.name: pk-open
events.description: It opened (the shortcut, show(), or open set by the host).

events.name: pk-close
events.description: A close was asked for (Escape, backdrop, the shortcut, hide()) or a command was chosen (reason "select", already closed). Cancelable except for "select": preventDefault keeps it open.

elements.name: pk-context-menu
elements.description: A menu opened at the pointer by right click, by Shift+F10 or the Menu key, or by a touch long press, over the region it wraps.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the menu is shown.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Leave the browser menu alone.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The region the menu belongs to.

events.name: pk-select
events.description: An item was chosen.

events.name: pk-open
events.description: It opened at the pointer position.

events.name: pk-close
events.description: A close was asked for (Escape, outside press, choosing an item). Cancelable: preventDefault keeps it open.

elements.name: pk-dialog

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether it is shown

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The heading setting

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The size setting

attributes.name: scrollable
attributes.description: The body scrolls inside a bounded dialog.

attributes.name: hide-close
attributes.description: Hide the header close button (the dialog offers its own Cancel in the footer).

attributes.name: max-width
attributes.description: Card width in pixels before the viewport clamp; 0 keeps the size preset.

attributes.name: tint
attributes.description: A tinted card: product (green wash) or archived (red wash).

attributes.name: controlled

events.name: pk-open

events.description: escape, close button or method.

attributes.name: label-position
attributes.description: Where the label sits.

attributes.name: decorative
attributes.description: Remove the separator role.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether it is shown

attributes.name: side
attributes.description: Edge it slides from.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: Title; also the accessible name.

attributes.name: persistent
attributes.description: The backdrop does not close it.

attributes.name: wide
attributes.description: A wider panel (up to 70% of the viewport).

attributes.name: controlled
attributes.description: The host owns open: close requests (Escape, close button, backdrop, swipe) only raise pk-close and never close the element; the host closes it by clearing open. Used by Blazor wrappers.

attributes.name: docked
attributes.description: A non-modal inspector: it sits inside the nearest positioned ancestor instead of the viewport, has no backdrop and no focus trap, and the page behind stays usable. Escape still asks to close.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Actions strip under the header (Save, Cancel).

events.name: pk-open
events.description: pk-open

events.name: pk-close
events.description: escape, backdrop, close button, swipe or method.

elements.name: pk-dropdown
elements.description: A menu opened from a trigger: buttons or links, headers, dividers, checkable items and submenus, with full keyboard support (arrows, Home, End, typeahead, Right/Left for submenus, Escape).

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the menu is shown.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred side.

attributes.name: keep-open
attributes.description: Stay open after an item is chosen (multi-select filters).

attributes.name: mega
attributes.description: A wide panel whose items flow into columns (navbar mega menu).

events.name: pk-select
events.description: An item was chosen.

events.name: pk-open
events.description: Opened.

events.name: pk-close
events.description: Closed.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The form field name.

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: Accepted types: extensions, MIME types or type/* (like the accept attribute).

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allows several files.

attributes.name: max-size
attributes.description: Largest file: 500KB, 5MB, 1GB or bytes.

attributes.name: max-files
attributes.description: Most files (multiple); 0 means no limit.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

events.name: change
events.description: The file list changed.

events.name: pk-files
events.description: Files were picked or dropped: those kept and those refused with a reason.

elements.name: pk-empty-state
elements.description: What a list shows when it has no rows: an optional icon, a title, a description and the actions that fill it. Densities for a whole page, a panel or a table row.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The title.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Heading level exposed to assistive technology.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The explanation.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Density and frame.

attributes.name: announce
attributes.description: Announce the element politely when it appears (role status), for results that replace a search.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Buttons that fill the empty state.

elements.name: pk-field

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The label text (or use the label slot).

attributes.name: help
attributes.description: Help text under the control.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: An error message; puts the control into the invalid state.

attributes.name: warning
attributes.description: A warning message; puts the control into the warning state.

attributes.name: required

attributes.name: level

attributes.description: Term beside value, or above it.

attributes.name: dividers

attributes.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Lowest number (the number, whatever the unit).

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Highest number.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: The number's step: any (the default) allows decimals, or a size such as 0.25 that the arrow keys move by.

events.name: input
events.description: The number was edited (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read the value from the element.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the number or picked another unit (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-value-change
events.description: The user committed a new value (same moment as change; carries the value).

elements.name: pk-workspace
elements.description: A tool page in panes: a nav pane, a main pane and an optional docked aside, each scrolling on its own. On a phone one pane shows at a time and a tab strip (Contents, Content, Details) switches it.

attributes.name: fill
attributes.description: Fill the height the parent gives it (a parent with a definite height, or a flex or grid parent) and drop the frame, for a tool that owns the whole page. Without it the workspace is as tall as the viewport minus a reserve.

attributes.name: active-pane
attributes.description: The pane shown on a phone. On a wider screen every pane shows. A pane that does not exist falls back to the main pane.

attributes.name: aside-open
attributes.description: Show the aside: a docked column on a wide screen, a panel over the main pane on a tablet and its own pane on a phone.

attributes.name: nav-label
attributes.description: The nav pane's accessible name and its tab on a phone.

attributes.name: main-label
attributes.description: The main pane's accessible name and its tab on a phone.

attributes.name: aside-label
attributes.description: The aside's accessible name and its tab on a phone.

slots.name: nav
slots.description: The nav pane: a file tree, a list of sections, filters. Leave it out for a two-pane workspace.

slots.name: aside
slots.description: The docked aside (an inspector or a details panel). It shows when asideOpen is set.

events.name: pk-pane-change
events.description: A tab in the phone strip was chosen. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the previous pane.
